objective: Maximize raw focal win rate, equal mean of each of six opponent-by-player-count cells, on canonical Pesten training rules.
seat_layout: One focal seat rotated through all positions on each deal, all other seats belong to the same frozen opponent.
selection: Use development games only. Prefer higher six-cell mean delta. Inspect per-opponent and format robustness. Freeze one candidate and its inference code before final comparison.
statistics: Wins divided by all games including draws. Candidate minus the original teacher on identical deal/seat/opponent configurations. Pointwise two-sided 95 percent paired normal intervals using independent deals within cell; propagate cell-mean variance with equal weights for aggregate interval.
speed: Matched steady-state wall time for full public PPO training epochs, equal schedule, games, optimizer work and model. Verify equivalent work. Report separate from candidate strength.
